blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Processing long videos with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is prohibitively expensive, making informative frame selection essential for accurate video understanding. The default uniform sampling often misses task-relevant keyframes, while recent training-free selectors instead pick frames by how well each one matches the question under an image-text alignment (ITA) score. However, we show that ITA signals correspond poorly with the MLLM's true needs: their rankings correlate weakly with downstream accuracy and are even negatively correlated on over 40% of questions, whereas the MLLM's internal yes/no judgment yields a much stronger signal. We present ProbFaS, a training- and label-free probabilistic pipeline that fuses both signals for key frame selection. ProbFaS treats dense ITA scores as cheap, biased measurements and sparse MLLM judgments as accurate, costly ones, unifying them via co-kriging, a multi-fidelity Gaussian process, to calibrate relevance across all frames. A temporal determinantal point process then selects frames capturing relevance peaks while preserving temporal coverage. Across Video-MME, MLVU and LongVideoBench, ProbFaS is the most accurate among fourteen state-of-the-art training-free selectors and uniform sampling in 13 of 15 settings (8-128 frames), outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 3.1 percentage points. On MLVU and LongVideoBench, 32 ProbFaS frames match or surpass the top baseline at 128 frames and uniform sampling with up to 768 frames.
blocks.zh: 使用多式大型语言模型(MLLMs)处理长相视频的费用太高,因此信息框的选择对准确理解视频至关重要。 默认的统一采样往往错过了与任务相关的密钥框架,而最近的无培训选择者则根据图像文本对齐(ITA)的分数来选择框架。 然而,我们显示,ITA信号与MLLM的真正需求不相称:其排名与下游准确性关系薄弱,甚至与超过40%的问题有负关联,而MLLM的内部是/否判断则产生更强的信号. 我们提出ProbFAS, 一个没有培训和标签的概率管道, 将两个信号都连接起来,用于选择关键框架。 ProbFAS将密集的ITA分数视为廉价,偏颇的测量,和稀疏的MLLM判断视为准确,昂贵的判断,通过多功能高斯进程(多功能高斯进程)的同心并用,来校正所有帧的相关性. 然后,一个时间决定因素点过程在保留时间覆盖范围的同时,选择捕获相关峰值的框架。 在整个Video-MME、MLVU和LongVideo Bench中,ProbFAS在15个环境(8-128个框架)中的13个中,在14个最先进的无培训选择者和统一取样中是最准确的,比最强基线表现最高可达3.1个百分点。 在MLVU和LongVideo Bench上,32 ProbFa 框架与128个框架和最多为768个框架的统一采样相匹配或超过最高基准。

blocks.en:
Current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) typically represent video inputs via sampled frames, each encoded into a sequence of visual tokens [ 2 , 48 , 73 ] .
A long video holds thousands of frames, but the context window, memory and latency limit a model to only a few dozen or a few hundred frames, making frame selection critical to performance. Standard uniform sampling can easily miss the brief window a question focuses on ( Fig. 2 ; more examples in Supp. D.6 ).
Training-free frame selectors offer an attractive solution, as they are lightweight, work with any frozen MLLM, and require no fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
目前多式大语言模型(MLLMs)一般通过取样框来代表视频输入,每个被编码成一串可视符号[2,48,73].
一段长相的视频持有上千帧,但上下文窗口,内存和后置性将模型限制在仅几十个或几百帧,使得帧选择对性能至关重要. 标准的统一抽样很容易错过一个问题所侧重的简短窗口(图2;Supp.D.6中的更多例子)。
无培训框架选择器提供了一种有吸引力的解决办法,因为它们是轻量级的,使用任何被冻结的MLLM,不需要微调。

blocks.en:
Most existing training-free selectors share a common paradigm [ 44 , 31 , 41 , 9 , 70 , 34 ] : an off-the-shelf vision-language model, such as CLIP, SigLIP, or BLIP [ 35 , 64 , 28 ] , scores the image–text alignment (ITA) between each frame and the question, after which a selection rule turns the scores into a frame set that balances relevance against diversity or coverage.
Though selection rules vary, they all assume that a frame ranked highly by the scoring model is necessarily more useful to the downstream MLLM.
We test this assumption directly ( Sec. 3 ) by measuring how much each frame helps the MLLM answer.
The agreement is weak: on Video-MME [ 13 ] the median within-question rank correlation of these alignment scores with actual frame usefulness is at most 0.08, with the ranking negatively correlated on over 40% of questions, and neither scaling to stronger scoring models nor fine-grained peak searching resolves this misalignment.
The answering MLLM itself is a consistently stronger judge: evaluating frames via a simple label-free yes/no query yields a top-ranked frame that correctly answers 60.1% of questions, compared to at most 54.4% for alignment scores.
However, querying the downstream MLLM across every frame of a long video introduces prohibitive computational costs, recreating the exact inference bottleneck frame selection aims to solve.
blocks.zh:
大多数现有的无培训选择者都有一个共同的范式[44,31,41,9,70,34]:一种现成的视觉语言模式,如CLIP,SigLIP,或BLIP [35,64,28],在每个帧和问题之间打分图像-文本相接(ITA),之后一个选择规则将分数变为一个框架集,平衡相关性与多样性或覆盖面.
虽然选取规则各有不同,但他们都认为一个被评分模型评分高的帧对下游的MLLM必然更有用.
我们直接测试这个假设(sec. 3 ),通过衡量每个帧对MLLM答案有多大帮助.
协议很弱:在Video-MME [13]上,这些对齐分数与实际帧用量的中位问题排名关联最多为0.08分,排名与40%以上的问题有负相关关系,且没有缩放到更强分数模型,也没有精细的峰值搜索解决了这种错位.
解答MLLM本身是一个一贯更强的判断:通过简单的无标签的是/否查询来评价帧产生一个排名最高的帧,正确回答60.1%的问题,而校正分数最多为54.4%.
然而,通过长相视频的每个帧来查询下游的MLLM,引入了令人望而却步的计算成本,重新创建准确的推断瓶颈框选择旨在解决.

blocks.en:
We introduce ProbFaS (probabilistic frame selection), which treats the relevance of a frame as a latent function of time observed through two measurements of different fidelity ( Fig. 4 ): dense alignment scores, which serve as a cheap but biased prior, and yes/no judgments of the answering MLLM on a small subset of frames, which act as accurate but costly references.
ProbFaS fuses them by co-kriging [ 23 ] , a multi-fidelity Gaussian process (GP) that learns per question how the alignment score maps to the MLLM’s judgment and propagates the remaining bias along the timeline while retaining its sharp peaks.
A temporal determinantal point process (DPP) then selects the k k optimal frames from this calibrated relevance, capturing relevance peaks while maintaining temporal coverage over the video.
ProbFaS requires no training, no labels and no auxiliary language model, incurring only minimal overhead from single-token logit evaluations on a small subset of frames.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了 ProbFAS(概率框架选择),它通过对不同忠贞度的两次测量(图4),将框架的相关性视为观测到的时间的潜在函数: 密集的对齐分数,作为廉价但偏颇的前作,以及回答的 MLLM 对一小段框架的肯定/否定判断,这些是准确而昂贵的参考。
ProbFAS通过联合克瑞格[23]将它们融为一体,这是一个多功能高斯进程(GP),它每个问题都了解对齐图如何与MLLM的判断一致,并在保持其尖锐的峰值的同时沿时间线传播所剩的偏差.
一个时间决定因素点过程(DPP)然后从这个校正的关联性中选择 kk 最佳帧,捕捉关联性峰值,同时保持视频上的时间覆盖.
ProbFAS不需要训练,没有标签和辅助语言模型,只从一个小片帧的单键登录评价中产生最低限度的间接费用.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • An analysis showing that the alignment scores used by training-free frame selectors poorly reflect what the answering MLLM needs, whereas an MLLM’s own label-free judgment is a significantly more accurate signal. • ProbFaS, to our knowledge the first frame selector that casts relevance estimation as multi-fidelity probabilistic inference: co-kriging fuses dense low-fidelity alignment scores with sparse judgments of the answering MLLM into a calibrated per-frame relevance, while a probabilistic sampling model, temporal DPP, selects relevant yet temporally diverse frames without a hand-set trade-off. The pipeline is training- and label-free and works with any pre-trained MLLM. • We demonstrate the effectiveness of ProbFaS on Video-MME, MLVU [ 75 ] and LongVideoBench [ 54 ] against fourteen training-free selectors at budgets of 8 to 128 frames ( Fig. 1 ): it is the most accurate in 13 of 15 settings, its 32 frames match or surpass the best baseline at 128 frames on MLVU and LongVideoBench ( Tab. 3 ), and its frame selections transfer across different answering models.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献是: 分析显示,无训练帧选择器所用的校正分数没有很好地反映解答MLLM需要的内容,而MLLM自己的无标签判断则是一个明显更准确的信号. · ProbFAS, 据我们所知,第一个框架选择器将相关估计作为多纤维概率推论:同杆引信将密集的低纤维调整分数与微小的判断结果,将解答的MLLM调整为每个框架的相关性,而概率取样模型Termic DPP则选择相关但时间上不同的框架,而不进行手定取舍。 输油管没有培训和标签,并与任何经过预先培训的MLLM合作。 我们在视频-MME、MLVU[75]和LongVideo Bench[54]对预算为8至128帧的14个免费培训选择者(图1)证明了ProbFAS的有效性:在15个设置中,它是13个设置中最准确的,其32个框架在MLVU和LongVideo Bench(图3)上匹配或超过128帧的最佳基线,其框架选择在不同的答题模式中转移。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Recent MLLMs extend the context length of the language model (LongVA [ 71 ] ) or train directly on long videos (LLaVA-Video [ 73 ] , Qwen2.5-VL [ 3 ] , Qwen3-VL [ 2 ] , InternVL3.5 [ 48 ] ), while alternative pipelines compress visual tokens via pruning (FastV [ 8 ] , DyCoke [ 45 ] ) or merging (LongVU [ 37 ] , VideoChat-Flash [ 30 ] ).
However, memory consumption and latency still scale with frame count; thus, MLLMs in practice receive a constrained frame budget, making selective frame sampling essential for effective long video understanding.
blocks.zh:
近期的MLLMs扩展了语言模型的上下文长度(LongVA [71])或直接在长相视频上进行列车(LLaVA-Video [73],Quen2.5-VL [3],Quen3-VL [2],InternVL3.5 [48]),而替代管线则通过推跑(FastV [8], DyCoke [45])或合并(LongVU [37],VideoChat-Flash [30])来压缩视觉标志.
然而,内存消耗和耐用性仍以帧计数为尺度;因此,MLLMs在实践中获得的帧预算有限,使得选择性帧采样对于有效的长相视频理解至关重要.

blocks.en:
Most training-free selectors score each frame against the question using an image–text alignment score (e.g., CLIP [ 35 ] , SigLIP [ 64 ] , or BLIP [ 28 ] ) and balance relevance against coverage by recursive splitting (AKS [ 44 ] ), sampling from the score distribution (BOLT [ 31 ] , AdaQ [ 70 ] , Q-Frame [ 72 ] , which also lowers the resolution of less relevant frames), a DPP (MDP 3 [ 41 ] , LDDR [ 6 ] ), an integer quadratic program (Nar-KFC [ 12 ] ), greedy subset objectives (MarKey [ 39 ] , FORGE [ 22 ] ), relevance-conditioned uniqueness (GIFT [ 32 ] ), wavelet denoising with segment boundaries (WFS-SB [ 9 ] ), the shape of the score curve (RIDGE [ 56 ] ) or query-guided partitions (QCA [ 34 ] ).
Other approaches extract attention weights from a smaller MLLM (DAFS [ 51 ] ), score candidate frames (FRAG [ 20 ] , UG-Sample [ 25 ] ) or frame groups (GridProbe [ 11 ] ) with the answering MLLM, spread sparse MLLM scores linearly (OTFS [ 74 ] ) or over a segment graph (VideoDetective [ 58 ] ), ground evidence via coverage heuristics (GCR [ 53 ] ), adapt to the query by routing (DIG [ 27 ] ) or spatial–temporal zooms (LENS [ 65 ] ), validate CLIP proposals with MLLMs (A.I.R. [ 77 ] ), refine the sampling distribution from object detections (T* [ 61 ] , Logic-in-Frames [ 15 ] ), reduce scoring cost by multi-armed bandits (FOCUS [ 76 ] ), adaptive budgets (CSES [ 68 ] ) or a GP surrogate (FORTE [ 21 ] ) of the alignment score, or select frames maximizing feature volume without considering the query (MaxInfo [ 29 ] ); MetaSampling [ 10 ] re-runs any selector per interval to pass fewer frames.
Most of these selectors equate raw alignment scores with the MLLM’s internal utility, mirroring information retrieval systems that conflate passage relevance with task utility [ 67 , 66 ] .
However, as shown in Sec. 3 , this alignment score is inherently weak and cannot be repaired by post-hoc score reshaping; ProbFaS instead measures the answering MLLM’s own judgment on a sparse frame set and models it probabilistically across the entire frame sequence.
Unlike OTFS, which interpolates sparse MLLM rewards linearly, ProbFaS uses the calibrated alignment score to fill the gaps between probes.
blocks.zh:
大多数无培训选择者使用图像-文本对齐分数(如CLIP [35],SigLIP [64],或BLIP [28])对每帧问题进行分数,并通过递归分数(AKS [44]),分数分配抽样(BOLT [31],AdaQ [70],Q-Frame [72],还降低了分数不太相关的分数),DPP(MDP 3 [41],LDDR [6]),整数四分数程序(Nar-KFC [12]),贪婪分出目标(MarKey [39],FORGE [22]),有相关条件的独特性(GIFT [32]),用分数边界去音(WFS-SB [9]),分数曲线形状(RIDGE [56]或查询制分数(QCA [34])等分数。
其他方法从一个较小的MLLM(DAFS [51]),分数候选帧(FRAG [20],UG-Samplle [25])或框架组(GridProbe [11])中提取注意分数,用回答的MLLLM,线性分散的MLLM分数(OTFS [74])或分数图(Video Detection [58]),通过覆盖率高低的地面证据(GCR [53]),通过路由(DIG [27])或空间-地表(LENS [65])来适应查询,用MLLMM(A.I.R.[77]来验证CLIP提案,从物体探测中完善取样分布(T* [61], Logic-in-Frames [15]),减少多武装土匪的分数成本(FOCUS [76],适应性预算(CESS [68])或一个GP附加数(FORS[21]),在不考虑对调和分数的评分数的29
这些选择者大多将原始校正分数与MLLM的内部功用等同起来,反映了将通过相关内容与任务功用相融合的信息检索系统[67,66].
然而,正如第3条所示,这一比分本来就是微弱的,无法通过后热分数重塑修复; ProbFAS 转而测量解答MLLM本身的判断,并在整个相框序列中进行概率模型测量。
与插入稀有MLLM线性奖励的OTFS不同,ProbFAS使用被校正的对齐分来填补探针之间的空隙.

blocks.en:
Agentic methods let LLMs or VLMs iteratively caption, retrieve or re-query frames.
VideoAgent [ 49 ] lets an LLM judge whether the captions so far suffice and otherwise retrieve frames with CLIP for queries it generates, VideoTree [ 52 ] clusters frames and expands the clusters an LLM rates relevant into a finer hierarchy, Temporal Chain of Thought [ 1 ] lets the VLM itself pick the relevant frames of each segment before answering, and Vgent [ 38 ] retrieves clips from an entity graph and filters them by yes/no verification with an LVLM.
Each question thus triggers several rounds of generation by large models, often with captions of many frames, so selection can cost far more than the answer.
blocks.zh:
代理方法允许 LLM 或 VLMs 迭代字幕,取回或重排帧.
VideoAgent [49] 让LLM判断迄今为止标题是否足够,并以CLIP检索其生成的询问的帧,VideoTree [52] 集群框架,并将集群的LLM率扩展为更细的层级,Temperal Cine of Thind [1] 让VLM自己在回答之前取出每个段的相关帧,而Vgent [38]从实体图中取出剪辑并用LVLM进行"是"/"不"的校验过滤.
每个问题都因此触发了由大型模型所引发的多轮生成,往往带有许多帧的字幕,因此选择的成本可能远大于答案.

blocks.en:
Learning-based selectors are trained on pseudo-labels or answerer feedback: SeViLA [ 62 ] refines a BLIP-2 keyframe localizer with pseudo-labels from its answerer, Frame-Voyager [ 63 ] learns to pick frame combinations ranked by a Video-LLM’s prediction loss, the selector of Hu et al . [ 19 ] is a small MLLM trained on pseudo-labels of frame importance, GenS [ 59 ] generates relevant frame spans with scores learned from GPT-4o labels, VideoITG [ 47 ] learns instructed frame selection from automatic annotations, ReQuest [ 24 ] distills an MLLM into a question-aware selector that rethinks when uncertain, and FFS [ 4 ] learns a policy that keeps a flexible number of frames.
Others train relevance scorers contrastively, FrameScout [ 18 ] with a frame–query objective for streaming selection and evidential keyframe sampling [ 50 ] on annotated answer-supporting segments, or learn to select by reinforcement learning: TSPO [ 43 ] trains an event-aware temporal agent, ViaRL [ 57 ] rewards a frame selector by answer accuracy, VideoMiner [ 5 ] searches a tree of segments, captions and clusters, K-frames [ 60 ] predicts query-relevant scene clips and converts them into any number of keyframes, and MSJoE [ 42 ] jointly trains the MLLM and a sampler over CLIP similarities to the MLLM’s own queries.
Video-MTR [ 55 ] and FrameThinker [ 16 ] go further and train the MLLM itself to request segments or zoom into frames over several reasoning turns.
These approaches need curated data and backbone-specific training.
ProbFaS requires neither interactive generation loops nor fine-tuning: like SeViLA [ 62 ] , it uses the answering MLLM as a judge at test time, but reads a single-token logit per probed frame, with no generation and no auxiliary language model.
blocks.zh:
学习型选择者接受伪标签或回答者反馈培训:SeVilA[62]用其回答者Frame-Voyager[63]的伪标签来改进BLIP-2键框定位器,学习选择由Video-LLM的预测损失排序的帧组合,Hu等人[19]的选取者是一个以有帧重要性的伪标签训练的小型MLLLM,GenS[59]用从GPT-4o标签中吸取的分数来产生相干框架跨度,VideoITG[47]从自动说明中学习到指示框选择,ReQuest[24]将MLLM提炼出一个在不确定时重新思考的问题意识选择器,FS[4]学习到一个保留灵活个帧数的政策.
其他培训相关计分员则形成对比,FramewsScout [18] 设定了用于在附加说明的回答支持部分上进行串流选择和证据密钥框取样的帧-query目标[50],或学习通过强化学习来进行选择:TSPO [43] 培训一个事件感应时间代理,ViaRL [57] 奖励一个帧选择者精确回答,VideoMiner [5]搜索一树段、标题和集群,K-frame [60] 预测与查询相关的场景剪辑并把它们转换成任何数量的密钥框,MSJoE [42] 联合培训MLLLM和一个样本者,以比照MLLM本身的查询。
Video-MTR [55] 和FrameThinker [16] 更进一步,训练MLLM本身在几个推理转折上请求段或缩放成帧.
这些方法需要整理数据和针对骨干的培训。
ProbFAS既不要求交互生成回路,也不要求微调:同SeVilA [62]一样,它使用解答MLLM作为测试时间的判断器,而是每个被探测到的框架读取一个单键的登录,没有生成,也没有辅助语言模型.

blocks.en:
Gaussian processes (GPs) [ 36 ] are standard surrogates for expensive functions, and GP-UCB [ 40 ] uses their uncertainty to decide where to evaluate next.
Co-kriging [ 23 ] models a high-fidelity, costly signal as a scaled low-fidelity observation plus a GP discrepancy, enabling sparse accurate measurements to calibrate dense biased priors; to our knowledge, it has not been applied to video frame selection.
FORTE [ 21 ] also places a GP over time, but to decide which frames to score with the alignment model, whereas ProbFaS uses it to correct the alignment score toward the answering MLLM.
DPPs are widely used to sample diverse subsets [ 26 , 17 ] , with greedy MAP inference [ 7 ] for the most probable subset, e.g . in video summarization [ 14 ] and frame selection (MDP 3 [ 41 ] , LDDR [ 6 ] ), where similarity is measured by visual features.
Simpler rules suppress the neighbors of each top-scoring pick (non-maximum suppression [ 19 ] ) or greedily maximize a coverage objective [ 39 , 22 ] .
ProbFaS uses a temporal DPP, which measures similarity by the time between frames.

blocks.en:
ProbFaS aims at selecting k k frames for a frozen MLLM that most effectively support the model in answering a question ( Fig. 4 ).
We cast selection as a probabilistic surrogate ( Sec. 4.1 ), infer the relevance it needs by fusing cheap alignment scores with a few MLLM probes ( Secs. 4.2 and 4.3 ), and select frames with a temporal DPP ( Sec. 4.4 ).

blocks.en: 5.1 Setup

blocks.en:
Video-MME [ 13 ] has 2,700 questions on 900 short (under 2 min), medium (4–15 min) and long (30–60 min) videos; we use it without subtitles.
MLVU [ 75 ] dev has 2,174 questions on 1,122 videos of 3 min to over 2 h in seven tasks; we report the official score, the mean of the task accuracies.
LongVideoBench [ 54 ] val has 1,337 questions on videos of 8 s to 1 h; we use its video-only variant.
All methods answer with the same frozen Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 2 ] in LMMs-Eval [ 69 ] with greedy decoding, at budgets k ∈ { 8 , 16 , 32 , 64 , 128 } k\in\{8,16,32,64,128\} ; every frame is resized to at most 786,432 pixels, and the selected frames are passed as an ordered image sequence.
Two methods are compared on the same questions by the paired McNemar statistic [ 33 ] z = ( n 10 − n 01 ) / n 10 + n 01 z=(n_{10}-n_{01})/\sqrt{n_{10}+n_{01}} , where n 10 n_{10} and n 01 n_{01} count the questions that only the first or only the second answers correctly; | z | > 1.96 |z|>1.96 means p < 0.05 p<0.05 .

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
Our findings show that the image–text alignment scores behind training-free frame selectors correlate poorly with an MLLM’s true downstream utility, whereas the model’s own yes/no judgment provides a much stronger selection signal.
To leverage both, ProbFaS formulates frame relevance as a multi-fidelity probabilistic process: co-kriging calibrates dense, low-cost relevance scores against sparse label-free judgments from the answering MLLM, and a temporal DPP selects a subset that balances relevance peaks with temporal coverage.
Without training or labels, it achieves the highest accuracy in 13 of 15 settings while keeping computational overhead low. On MLVU and LongVideoBench its 32 selected frames match or surpass the best baseline at 128 frames and uniform sampling with up to 768 frames.
blocks.zh:
我们的调查结果表明,图像-文本比无训练框架选择器的得分与MLLM的真正下游用途关系不佳,而模型本身的“是/否”判断则提供了更强大的选择信号。
为了同时发挥杠杆作用,ProbFAS将框架关联性制定为一个多真实概率过程:同调校出密集而低成本的关联性分数与解答MLLLM的零散无标签判断相比,一个时间DPP选择一个子集,在关联性高峰与时间覆盖之间保持平衡.
没有培训或标签,它在15个设置中的13个设置中达到了最高的准确度,同时保持了计算间接费用的低水平. 在MLVU和LongVideo Bench上,它挑选的32个帧与128个帧和统一取样最多768个帧匹配或超过最佳基线。

blocks.en:
Our single-token probe evaluates frames independently, so it does not explicitly capture inter-frame compositional dependencies; consequently, ProbFaS yields smaller gains on tasks requiring multi-event synthesis, such as Video-MME counting or global video synopses, and its relative advantage decreases on Video-MME under higher frame budgets.
Additionally, probe evaluation introduces m m single-frame forward passes and relies on an MLLM capable of reliable single-frame confidence calibration: performance degrades when paired with smaller or weaker judge models ( e.g . LLaVA-Video-7B or Qwen3-VL-2B).
blocks.zh:
我们的单键探测器独立地评价帧,因此它没有明确地捕捉到帧间构成依赖;因此,ProbFAS在需要多事件合成的任务上,如Video-MME计数或全球视频概要上,其相对优势在更高的帧预算下会降低.
此外,探测器评估还引入了m m 单帧前行传出,并依赖于能够可靠地进行单帧置信校正的MLLM:性能在与更小或更弱的判断模型配对时会退化(例如. LLaVA-Video-7B或Quen3-VL-2B).

blocks.en: B.3 Kernel of the discrepancy
blocks.zh: B.3 差异的核心

blocks.en:
The discrepancy δ ⁡ ( t ) \delta(t) models how the bias of the alignment score drifts along the timeline.
We use a Matérn- 5 2 \tfrac{5}{2} kernel [ 36 ] , whose sample paths are twice differentiable: smooth enough to carry a bias across the gaps between probes, which are about n / m n/m seconds apart, yet able to change within a scene.
A Matérn- 1 2 \tfrac{1}{2} (exponential) kernel gives rough paths whose posterior mean reverts quickly to zero between probes, and a squared-exponential kernel gives very smooth paths that can oscillate between widely spaced probes.
In all cases the length scale is fitted per question, so the kernel family mainly sets how quickly the correction decays away from a probe.

A later frame is chosen only if its relevance outweighs its loss of novelty: a frame next to a chosen peak must be far more relevant than a frame in an uncovered part of the video.
Two limits show the trade-off.
When r ^ \hat{r} is constant, the gain depends only on ν \nu and the greedy spreads the frames over the timeline like a space-filling design; when r ^ \hat{r} has a few isolated peaks far above the rest, the greedy takes the peaks first, at most one per neighborhood of width about ℓ \ell , as non-maximum suppression would.
The temporal DPP interpolates between these behaviors according to the calibrated relevance of each question, without a hand-set trade-off weight.

blocks.en:
LENS first asks the answering MLLM, in a text-only call, how to split the k k images between a spatial and a temporal zoom.
Spatial-zoom frames are chosen by BLIP matching scores and keep their resolution, with query-irrelevant regions masked by CLIP attention.
Each temporal-zoom slot, chosen by a graph diffusion over the scores, is a hyperframe that tiles four consecutive candidate frames into a 2 × 2 2\times 2 image downscaled to the original frame size.
These images do not fit the frame-index protocol of the other methods, so we run the released pipeline end to end, with its default settings, BLIP as its scoring model and Qwen3-VL-8B as the answering model, which receives the k k images as a video, as in the released code.
We score its answers by the predicted option letter, like every other method.
Its own evaluation counts an answer as correct when the answer letter occurs anywhere in the prediction, which accepts, for example, “(B) Driver’s view” for the answer D, and raises its question accuracy on MLVU and LongVideoBench by 0.8 to 2.4 points.
The pipeline fails on 3 MLVU and 5 LongVideoBench questions whose text exceeds the 512 tokens of its scoring model; we count them as wrong, which lowers its scores by at most 0.4 points.
blocks.zh:
LENS首先询问答案的MLLM,在一个只使用文本的呼叫中,如何将 k k 图像在空间和时间缩放之间分割.

每个时段-分数槽,通过一个图表在分数上被所选择,是一个超帧,将四个连续的候选相框打入一个2×2 2\times 2的图像被缩小到原来的相框大小.
这些图像不符合其他方法的帧-index协议,因此我们运行已发布的管道端以结束,其默认设置,BLIP作为它的评分模型,而Qune3-VL-8B作为解答模型,它作为视频接收了k k 图像,如同已发布的代码.
我们像其他方法一样,通过预测的选项字母来评分答案。
其自己的评价认为,当在预测中任何地方发生回信时,答案是正确的,例如,答案D接受 " B. Driver ' s view " ,并将其在MLVU和LongVideo Bench上的问题精确度提高0.8至2.4分.
输油管在3个MLVU和5个LongVideo Bench的问题上失败了,这些问题的文本超过了它的得分模型的512个符号;我们算它们错了,这最多降低了它的得分0.4分.

blocks.en: C.3 Other answering models
blocks.zh: C.3 联合国 其他答题模式

blocks.en:
LLaVA-Video-7B-Qwen2 [ 73 ] runs through the llava_vid wrapper of LMMs-Eval with the qwen_1_5 conversation template and exactly 32 frames.
InternVL3.5-8B [ 48 ] runs through the internvl3_5 wrapper in video mode, with two tiles and a thumbnail per frame and the prompt “Frame i i : <image> ”.
Neither model receives frame timestamps, so uniform sampling and replayed lists reach the model in the same form.
With uniform sampling, LLaVA-Video-7B scores 62.5 on Video-MME and 58.5 on LongVideoBench at 32 frames, in line with the published 63.3 and 58.2 at 64 frames.
For the own-probe runs, each model judges the same probe set as Qwen3-VL-8B with the same yes/no prompt, each frame preprocessed as in its 32-frame answer pass; calibration, DPP and gap fill are unchanged.
For LLaVA-Video we also mapped its margins, per benchmark and without labels, to the mean and spread of the Qwen3-VL-8B margins; this gives 64.1, 70.1 and 60.5 on Video-MME, MLVU and LongVideoBench, against 64.7, 69.4 and 61.0 without the mapping.
MDP 3 ’s lists are empty for the three questions of one LongVideoBench video; for those questions every wrapper falls back to uniform frames, as in Tab. 2 .
blocks.zh:
LLaVA-Video-7B-Qwen2 [73]通过LMMs-Eval的lava_vid包装机以qwen_1_5对话模板并精确地32帧.
InternVL3.5-8B [48]在视频模式下通过Internvl3_5包装机,每帧有两块瓦片并有一个缩略图并有"Frame i:<image>"的快取.
两个模型都接收到帧时间戳,因此统一的采样和重放列表以同一种形式到达模型.
通过统一的取样,LLaVA-Video-7B在Video-MME和LongVideo Bench上的分数分别为62.5分和58.5分,分别为32分和58.2分和64分。
对于自有的probe跑道,每个模型判断出与Qwen3-VL-8B相同的探测器设置,具有相同的是/不是即时,每个帧的预处理,如同其32帧的接通接通;校正,DPP和空隙填充没有变化.
对于LLaVA-Video公司,我们还按基准和无标签地绘制了Qun3-VL-8B边的平均值和分布;在Video-MME、MLVU和LongVideo Bench上,这给出了64.1、70.1和60.5的幅度,而没有绘制了64.7、69.4和61.0的幅度。
MDP 3的榜单对于一个LongVideo Bench视频的三个问题是空的;对于那些问题,每张包装都回到了统一的框上,如Tab. 2 (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en:
InternVL3.5-8B with its own probe is within about one point of the Qwen-probe lists on MLVU and LongVideoBench ( z = − 1.1 z=-1.1 on both).
LLaVA-Video-7B with its own probe loses 0.9 to 2.9 points against the Qwen-probe lists ( z = − 1.4 z=-1.4 , − 3.6 -3.6 and − 2.4 -2.4 on Video-MME, MLVU and LongVideoBench), though it stays above uniform sampling.
Its ranking of the probe frames agrees less with that of Qwen3-VL-8B (median Spearman 0.53–0.61, against 0.61–0.70 for InternVL), and its yes/no margins span 8 to 12 times less (4 to 5 times less for InternVL).
Unlike for the 2B probe ( Sec. D.2 ), the mapping of its margins above does not help consistently, so the limit is its ranking, not its scale.
blocks.zh:
带有自己探测器的InternVL3.5-8B大约在MLVU和LongVideo Bench(z=- 1.1 z=-1.1)上所列出的文-probe清单的一分之内.
LLaVA-Video-7B携带自有探测器,但相对于Quen-probe列表(z = − 1.4 z =- 1.4),在Video-MME,MLVU和LongVideo Bench上,LLaVA-Video-7B损失了0.9到2.9分,尽管它停留在统一的取样之上.
它的探测帧排名与Qune3-VL-8B(中间斯皮尔曼为0.53–0.61,而InternVL为0.61–0.70)的排名不太一致,它的"是"/"否"的比值相差8-12倍(InternVL为4-5倍).
与2B探测器(Sec. D.2.)不同,其上方边距的地平线的测绘没有一致的帮助,因此极限是它的排名,而不是它的尺度.

blocks.en:
DAFS [ 51 ] , a training-free selector that reads relevance from the attention of a 2B MLLM in one forward pass, reports results for the same two answering models in its own setup ( Tab. 5 , bottom; resolution, prompts and candidate pool not stated).
Its uniform baselines differ from ours (62.9 against 60.2 for InternVL on LongVideoBench), so we compare gains over each setup’s own uniform sampling, on Video-MME, MLVU and LongVideoBench: with InternVL, DAFS gains 3.0, 2.7 and 2.9 points and ProbFaS 2.2, 5.9 and 4.0 (own probe 2.5, 5.3 and 3.0); with LLaVA-Video, DAFS gains 3.1, 2.7 and 2.7 and ProbFaS 3.1, 7.3 and 4.6.
ProbFaS thus gains more on MLVU and LongVideoBench and as much or less on Video-MME; in absolute accuracy DAFS is ahead with InternVL on Video-MME and LongVideoBench.
blocks.zh:
DAFS [51],一个免费的培训选择器,从一个向前传的2B MLLM的注意力中读出相关性,报告结果为同一两个答录模式在自己的设置中(Tab. 5, Bottom;解析度,提示和候选集合没有说明).
其统一基线与我们的基线不同(长维多本奇的 " INNVL " 与60.2的 " INNVL " 不同),因此我们比较了每个机构在Video-MME、MLVU和LongVideo Bench的统一取样方面的收益:InternVL、DAFS增益3.0、2.7和2.9分以及ProbFAS 2.2、5.9和4.0(拥有2.5、5.3和3.0号探测器);LLAVA-Video、DAFS增益3.1、2.7和2.7以及ProbFAS 3.1、7.3和4.6。
ProbFAS因此在MLVU和LongVideo Bench以及Video-MME上获得了更多收益;在绝对准确性上,DAFS领先于Video-MME和LongVideo Bench上的InternVL.

Judging every frame of the grid ( Tab. 6 ) adds 0.2–0.4 points at k ≤ 32 k\leq 32 on Video-MME and 0.7 and 0.8 points at k = 64 k=64 and 128, mostly on long videos.
It is not an upper bound: at k = 32 k=32 it adds 0.8 points on MLVU and loses 1.0 on LongVideoBench ( z = 0.3 z=0.3 and − 1.2 -1.2 ; Tab. 5 ).
Its gain at large k k needs near-dense probing and is not reached by doubling m m .

Probing with the answering model itself avoids this calibration.

Instead of placing all probes at once, 32 probes are placed by the score-peak and uniform rule, the calibration is fitted, and the remaining 32 probes go where g ⁡ ( t ) + 2 ​ v ⁡ ( t ) g(t)+2\sqrt{v(t)} is largest, updating v ⁡ ( t ) v(t) after each pick as if the probe had been observed [ 40 ] .

Each probe shows the MLLM the clip ( t , t + 1 ​ s ) (t,t+1\,\mathrm{s}) instead of a single frame, at the same token cost, so that it can see motion.
Its margins are about 1.3 times narrower than single-frame margins; the LongVideoBench entry rescales them by 1.3 (67.8 without rescaling).
It helps motion and counting questions and costs detail questions about equally.

它有助于移动和计算问题和费用,同时详细列出问题。

Qwen3-VL merges every two consecutive input frames into one token group.
Selecting k / 2 k/2 frames and showing each with its neighbor one second later makes every group a 1 s clip, but shows half as many distinct moments; it ties on Video-MME and LongVideoBench and loses on MLVU, where the order and plot tasks need many distinct events.

blocks.en:
Table 7 in the main paper gives the selection times by video duration, with videos on local disk and decoding included.
ProbFaS takes 11.5 s per question, about a quarter of LENS, QCA and AKS, a sixth of A.I.R., a seventh of DIG and a twelfth of OTFS; DIG and OTFS in addition call an 80B LLM to route each query.
It is close to AdaQ, FRAG and FOCUS, and about three times BOLT and twice MDP 3 .
The 64 probes cost 3.5 s and grow only slightly with the length of the video (2.7 to 4.0 s), since m m is fixed.
The rest is the BLIP-2 grid, which grows linearly with the length and dominates on long videos (19.5 of 23.7 s); it is the grid WFS-SB also scores, so ProbFaS costs WFS-SB plus 3.5 s.

blocks.en:
Table 7 uses 30 Video-MME videos, 10 per duration group drawn with a fixed seed, with all their 90 questions (8.3 hours of video).
Each method runs as its own job on one GH200 GPU with 16 CPU cores and the videos copied to node-local disk, so that file-system load does not enter.
Model loading is excluded, and the first video is processed once more as a warm-up and not recorded.
Times include video decoding where the method decodes; work done once per video, such as image features, is divided among the questions on that video.
Baselines run with their released code as is, except BOLT, WFS-SB and the reward step of DIG. BOLT is timed with our implementation of its pipeline, CLIP-L/14 on the 1 fps grid once per video followed by inverse transform sampling; it uses the 336 px model rather than the 224 px model of the release, so its time is an upper estimate. WFS-SB runs its released selector (wavelet denoising, adaptive budget allocation and diversity-aware intra-segment selection) on the ProbFaS BLIP-2 grid, which adds 7 ms per question.
The released code measures diversity in the intra-segment step with BLIP-2 image embeddings when they are given and by temporal distance otherwise; as in our WFS-SB runs of Tab. 2 , the grid stores no embeddings, so the timing uses temporal distance.
FOCUS and A.I.R. do not expose per-question times, so we divide the wall-clock time of the whole run by 90; for A.I.R. this includes the answer pass and model loading (77.5 s), hence the approximate selection time of 75 s.
DIG first picks shot frames from DINOv2 features at 2 fps and then asks the answering MLLM for a reward on each shot frame with its prompt; one reward takes 0.81 s at batch 16, with 21, 93 and 448 shot frames per local question on short, medium and long videos.
We time up to 32 rewards per question and extrapolate to all shot frames.
Its 80B query router is not timed, and the vLLM deployment of its release would generate faster than our implementation, so the reward part is an upper estimate.
